body_text:
Fix a deductive system. A *derivation* of $\varphi$ from
premises $\Gamma$ is a finite sequence or tree of formulas in
which every leaf is an axiom or a member of $\Gamma$, and every
other formula follows from earlier formulas by an allowed
inference rule. We write $\Gamma\vdash\varphi$ when such a
derivation exists. The symbol $\vdash$ concerns formal
derivability; $\models$ concerns truth in models.
